wiki.title: One of Three
wiki.text:
One of Three is an enemy NPC that can be found wandering designated spawn areas that include: West of the Greenwood Forest warpstone, near a bumbleberry patch located in Queensfields, and south of a cave in the Cobblestone Village.

Trivia
One of Three was introduced in-game on October 1st, 2013.
